_comment: #016b-mini probe loss: same as #016's loss EXCEPT `snr_x0_mode: true`. Switches the Min-SNR formula from the eps-prediction form `min(snr,gamma)/snr` to the x0-prediction form `min(snr,gamma)` (Hang 2023 §4.2). Everything else identical so any delta in training behaviour is attributable to the formula switch.
